==Usage==
Copy the template code below, and paste it into an article's reference note. Fill in as many parameters as you can, remove any that you don't use.

<code><nowiki>{{DPB|url=|text=|author=|date=|archivedate=|archiveurl=|archivefile=|nobackup=|nolive=}}</nowiki></code>

===Required parameters===
*{{Para|url}} The URL of the web page, minus <code><nowiki>https://disneyparks.disney.go.com/blog/</nowiki></code>.
*{{Para|text}} The formatted text to display.
*For '''archive''' options, see [[#Backup links|Backup links]] below.

===Optional parameters===
*{{Para|author}} Name(s) of the author(s). Must be formatted like "<code>Last name, First name</code>"; multiple authors must be separated with a "<code>;</code>" between their names. Note that an author is not necessarily an individual and could be an organization. A long list of authors can be reduced using "<code>, et al.</code>" after the first name. Provide wikilinks whenever they are available.
*{{Para|date}} Full date of publication, in [[Wikipedia:ISO 8601|ISO 8601]] <code>YYYY-MM-DD</code> format, for example "<code>date=2006-02-17</code>".
*{{Para|nolive}} When the original online content is no longer available, add "<code>nolive=1</code>".

===Backup links===
{{BackupLinkHelp}}

==Example(s)==
<code><nowiki>{{DPB|url=2017/08/star-wars-galaxys-edge-construction-milestone-celebrated-at-disneyland-park|text=''Star Wars'': Galaxy’s Edge Construction Milestone Celebrated at Disneyland Park|author=Savvas, George|date=2017-08-22|archivedate=20200628091123}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{DPB|url=2017/08/star-wars-galaxys-edge-construction-milestone-celebrated-at-disneyland-park|text=''Star Wars'': Galaxy’s Edge Construction Milestone Celebrated at Disneyland Park|author=Savvas, George|date=2017-08-22|archivedate=20200628091123}}
